 Match Preview
 Championship - Game Week 15 7 Nov 2026 - 05:30 SToK Cae Ras Wrexham host Wolverhampton Wanderers at SToK Cae Ras in the EFL Championship, with Phil Parkinson's side facing one of the toughest tests of their season against a Wolves team sitting second in the table.
 The Red Dragons arrive into this fixture having beaten Middlesbrough 2-0 in their last outing, a result that will have lifted spirits considerably after back-to-back defeats to Sheffield United and Blackburn Rovers. That win snapped a difficult run and gave Parkinson's squad a timely confidence boost ahead of a match that demands a similar level of collective effort.
 Wrexham sit 16th in the Championship standings, and while the Middlesbrough result eased some of the pressure, the club cannot afford to slip back into the inconsistency that has defined much of their campaign. The absence of key attackers has blunted their threat in the final third, and that problem has not gone away.
 Wolves, managed by Cesar Peixoto, travel to north Wales in outstanding form. They have won four of their last five Championship outings, including a 1-2 win at Bristol City most recently and a 3-0 victory over Cardiff City before that, and they arrive as genuine promotion contenders with momentum firmly on their side.
 Peixoto's side have conceded just once across their last three matches and carry the kind of defensive solidity that makes them difficult to break down. For a Wrexham attack still missing key personnel, manufacturing chances against this Wolves backline will be a significant challenge.
 The contrast in league position tells its own story. Wolves are pushing for automatic promotion while Wrexham are battling to establish a safe distance from the bottom three. Both sides have clear motivation, but for entirely different reasons.
